extracted.name: Corn O'Brien
extracted.description: Corn is cooked with bacon and bell pepper in this Irish-inspired Corn O'Brien side dish.
ingredient_lines: 2 slices bacon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instruction_lines: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet; cook and stir over medium heat until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain bacon on a paper towel-lined plate, leaving grease in the skillet.

Stir onion and bell pepper into the skillet; cook until onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Add corn, pimento peppers, and reserved bacon. Cook and stir until heated through, 3 to 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
